label: Hidden Button (No Stay)
description: The hidden button collar stay system uses small buttons sewn to the underside of the collar point that fasten through a buttonhole on the shirt yoke or front — functionally similar to a button-down collar but invisible from the outside. This hybrid system maintains the clean, uncluttered look of a spread or cutaway collar while ensuring the points lie flat and still without visible buttons. It is a signature feature of Eton shirts and some Continental bespoke makers who value structured collar presentation with formal aesthetics.
